applied_settings: ***TUNED - SPLIT-REGION CURVE, Afterburner Profile 5, memory +2500, power limit 111% = 200 W. NOT STOCK.*** PURPOSE: the first sweep in this project collected with HWiNFO voltage logging alongside since the mechanism work of 2026-08-21. The abba-20260908 result - that the efficiency optimum tracks the applied V/F curve, shifting +465 MHz in 12 of 12 workloads - rests on a DECODED INTENDED curve and on a 0.720 V floor borrowed from a different run on a different configuration. This sweep observes the voltage instead of inferring it. HWiNFO logging to data/HWiNFO-Data/hwinfo-20260908-p5-splitcurve-gemm.csv at 2 s polling; join with tools/frequency-sweep/join_hwinfo_voltage.py, which bins by CORE CLOCK rather than timestamp. CONFIGURATION IDENTIFICATION IS POST-HOC BY DESIGN: no pre-run fingerprint probe was run, because a locked probe at 2010 MHz would inject samples into the same clock bin the join uses for that sweep point. Enforced power limit reads 200 W before launch, which rules out stock (180 W) without load; profile 5 versus profile 4 is settled from this sweep's own power curve, ~108.8 W versus ~79.5 W at a locked 2010 MHz, and from its top achieved clock, ~2977 versus ~2964. Profile 4 was edited earlier today to raise its plateau 3015 -> 3030, so both profiles now share a plateau and differ only in the low band - see data/afterburner-profiles/. Driver 616.64. Preflight verified quiet: encoder 0%, decoder 0%, GPU 4% flat over ten samples, 15412 MiB free, 44 C - clears the ~5% protocol bar.
